ssh.name: Connection name
ssh.host: IP, hostname or SSH Host alias
ssh.auth: Uses system OpenSSH, default keys and ssh-agent. Confirm non-interactive access to the same target in your terminal first. Passwords and private keys are not stored here.
ssh.mutation_notice: This operation affects only the selected Linux host. It may restart DSH and interrupt running tasks. Confirm that no running task needs to be preserved.
ssh.adopt: Use this user's existing ~/.dsh data and let Desktop manage DSH. Stop existing DSH processes first. Global installations will not be upgraded.
ssh.adopt_required: Existing installation or data found. Confirm adoption first.
ssh.restore_notice: Restores the pre-upgrade data snapshot. Newer data is preserved separately in the remote backup directory. DSH will stop and restart.
ssh.lifecycle: Disconnecting closes only the SSH tunnel; remote DSH keeps running and listens only on loopback.
ssh.version_required: Select or enter an exact version.
ssh.unavailable: SSH plugin unavailable. Check system Node and installer contents.
